title: Context Windows, Attention Attenuation & Sampling Parameters
description: Understand context window limits, the 'Lost in the Middle' retrieval degradation, and tune inference hyperparameters in .NET.

data.text: The Realities of Large Context Windows

While frontier models now boast massive context windows (128,000 tokens for GPT-4o, 2,000,000 tokens for Gemini 1.5 Pro), treating context as an infinite dumping ground is a dangerous anti-pattern. Beyond financial costs ($1.00+ per query when passing 200k tokens), LLMs suffer from severe attention degradation when processing voluminous contexts.

Extensive empirical research demonstrates a U-shaped accuracy curve: models exhibit high recall when relevant facts are placed at the very beginning (Primacy bias) or the very end (Recency bias) of the prompt, but accuracy degrades significantly when critical facts are buried in the middle 60% of a massive context window. This makes precise RAG retrieval and reranking essential, even when a model's context window could technically accommodate the entire document repository.
